bianbai.name: Defense
bianbai.desc: Play when impeached to cancel this impeachment.

dadian.name: Bribe
dadian.desc: If you spin Graft this round, ignore the step loss or dismissal.

addrank.name: Promotion
addrank.desc: If you spin Virtue or Talent this round, the destination moves up one identity tier (position unchanged).

jiji.name: Rank Boost
jiji.desc: This round: +1 identity tier and advance 1 cell, then draw 1 card.

qingke.name: Retainer
qingke.desc: If you spin Graft this round, its effect is completely negated.

phrases.家境清寒的乡间少年，白日帮家中料理农事，入夜伴着一盏油灯读书。几册旧书翻得起毛，: A poor country boy who farms by day and reads by lamplight. He hopes letters will change his fate, though he knows little of the world's ways.
phrases.生于清寒之家，靠针线活补贴家用，也从旧书残页中学得诗文。白日操持生计，夜里收起针: Born to a poor family, she sews to make ends meet and learns poetry from torn pages. Every scrap of paper matters; one day she hopes to enter the exam hall on her own writing.
phrases.生长于书香之家，自幼有长辈指点文章，也有藏书可供翻阅。赴考所需多已备齐，家中却也: Raised among books with elders guiding his prose, he starts with every advantage — and the weight of the family name on his shoulders.
phrases.早年已经成家，姓名籍贯一直登记于乡里，后来暂别家室，离乡游历天下。如今归来，仍有: A settled family man who left home to roam the realm. Now returned, he starts the exams again: quick-witted from travel, rusty in the classics.
phrases.在乡间设馆授徒多年，教过的蒙童已有人成家，自己却仍未取得生员功名。经书章句熟记于: A village tutor for many years, he knows the classics by heart yet never earned the licentiate degree. He never gave up on sitting the exam once more.
phrases.自小在铺面中长大，熟悉账册往来，也懂得谋生不易。家中靠正当买卖立业，有本籍可查，: Raised in a shop, she knows ledgers and hard earnings. While minding the business she studies for the exams, streetwise in resources but patient with the classics.
phrases.本局第一次掷出“德”时，若原规则目的格仍在白丁至榜眼范围，将目的格按身份阶次提高: First Virtue spin: raise the destination by one identity tier (up to Top Laureate) and settle only the final cell.
phrases.本局第一次掷出“赃”时，完成原有处罚后，额外失去1点资望。: First Graft spin: after the normal penalty, lose 1 extra Renown.
phrases.自己掷出“才”并完成常规结算后，可弃置1张功能手牌，额外获得3点资望，每局最多发: After your Talent spin resolves, discard 1 action card to gain 3 Renown (twice per game).
phrases.发动效果需要消耗手牌，没有手牌时不能发动。: The effect costs a card; it cannot be used with an empty hand.
phrases.完成正常起始发牌后，额外获得2张功能牌。: After the normal opening deal, gain 2 extra action cards.
phrases.本局第一次掷出“赃”时，完成原有处罚后，额外失去2点资望。: First Graft spin: after the normal penalty, lose 2 extra Renown.
phrases.自己的常规转掷结束、尚未结算时，可弃置1张功能手牌，重掷1次，每局最多发动2次。: After your spin but before settlement, discard 1 action card to spin again (twice per game).
phrases.必须接受第二次结果；本次行动已经重掷过，或没有手牌时，不能发动。: You must accept the second result; cannot be used twice in one action or without a card.
phrases.自己掷出“才”并完成常规结算后，可支付1点资望，从弃牌堆中选择1张功能牌加入手牌: After your Talent spin resolves, pay 1 Renown to take 1 action card from the discard pile (twice per game).
phrases.资望不足1点，或弃牌堆没有功能牌时，不能发动。: Requires at least 1 Renown and an action card in the discard pile.
phrases.自己的正常回合开始、转掷之前，可支付1点资望并弃置1张功能手牌，抽取2张功能牌，: At the start of your turn before spinning, pay 1 Renown and discard 1 action card to draw 2 (twice per game).
phrases.资望不足1点、没有手牌，或牌堆不足2张时，不能发动。: Requires 1 Renown, a card in hand, and at least 2 cards in the deck.
phrases.点击手牌查看牌义: Tap a card to read it
phrases.暂无结算记录，转一次陀螺即可查看。: No settlement yet. Spin once to see the details.
phrases.科举段（生员→状元）：直接升至判词指定阶次，不逐阶停留: Exam stage (Shengyuan → Zhuangyuan): jump straight to the tier named in the verdict.
phrases.科举段：按判词正常逐阶晋升: Exam stage: advance tier by tier as the verdict says.
phrases.翰林才俊纪昀转出「才」额外多走 1 格: Ji Yun (Hanlin Talent) moves 1 extra cell on Talent.
phrases.科举段：依判词晋身，前进 1 格: Exam stage: advance 1 cell per the verdict.
phrases.九品段：进 1 格（品级不变，沿当前线路前进一步）: Ranked office: move 1 cell forward on the current line.
phrases.科举段：按判词降罚，重者革职退出科举: Exam stage: demote per the verdict; severe cases are dismissed.
phrases.外官德政林则徐转出「赃」额外多走 1 格: Lin Zexu (Virtuous Official) moves 1 extra cell on Graft.
phrases.曾国藩转出「赃」不革职: Zeng Guofan is never dismissed on Graft.
phrases.德：九品段升1阶；科举段超擢至判词指定阶次: Virtue: +1 tier in ranked office; leap to the verdict tier in exams.
phrases.才：九品段同品平调；科举段逐阶正常晋升: Talent: lateral transfer in ranked office; normal tier-by-tier advance in exams.
phrases.功：九品段进1格（品级不变）；科举段前进1格: Merit: move 1 cell (rank unchanged) in ranked office; advance 1 cell in exams.
phrases.赃：九品段降1阶；科举段按判词降罚，重者革职: Graft: -1 tier in ranked office; demote per verdict in exams, dismissal if severe.
phrases.科举段内依十五阶身份顺序行进（白丁→童生→案首→监生→生员→廪生→贡生→举人→解: In the exam stage, move through the 15 ranks in order (Baiding → Tongsheng → Anshou → Jiansheng → Shengyuan → Linsheng → Gongsheng → Juren → Jieyuan → Jinshi → Erjia → Huiyuan → Tanhua → Bangyan → Zhuangyuan).
phrases.状元后进入殿试环节，依结果授予翰林院编修 / 六部主事 / 外官等不同身份: After Zhuangyuan comes the palace exam, assigning Hanlin compiler, ministry secretary, or regional posts.
phrases.纪昀 · 翰林才俊：翰林段转出「才」额外多走 1 格: Ji Yun · Hanlin Talent: in the Hanlin stage, Talent moves 1 extra cell.
phrases.林则徐 · 外官德政：外官段转出「德」额外多走 1 格: Lin Zexu · Virtuous Official: in the regional stage, Virtue moves 1 extra cell.
phrases.曾国藩 · 不革职：本局转出「赃」不触发革职: Zeng Guofan · Never Dismissed: Graft never triggers dismissal.

phrases.参劾 / 辩白 / 打点 / 花红 / 加官 / 带级 / 清客：按卡牌规则对自: Impeachment / Defense / Bribe / Bonus / Promotion / Rank Boost / Retainer: apply per card rules.

phrases.品级 +1 且前进 1 格（升半阶兼自动前进一格）。: Rank +1 and advance 1 cell (a half-tier raise also moves you forward one cell).
phrases.骰面释义：德为超迁，才为序升，功为寸进，赃为降黜: Faces: Virtue = leap, Talent = step up, Merit = advance, Graft = demotion
phrases.点击名次查看对应结局卡: Tap a rank to view its ending card
phrases.轮流「跳过出牌 → 转陀螺」推进仕途，先到三公者荣归。: Take turns playing a card or skipping, then spin; the first to the Three Excellencies wins.

phrases.Candidates examined in prefectures and c: Candidates examined in prefectures and counties or by the education commissioner sit the child exam, commonly called the minor test; those sitting it are called tongsheng.

phrases.There are four kinds of jiansheng: by gr: There are four kinds of jiansheng: by grace, by hereditary privilege, by selection, and by donation.
phrases.Qing Shi Gao, vol. 106, Elections I, Sch: Qing Shi Gao, vol. 106, Elections I, Schools I
phrases.Categories of shengyuan: stipended, expa: Categories of shengyuan: stipended, expanded and supplementary; a new entrant is a supplementary shengyuan.
phrases.The stipended and expanded quotas are fi: The stipended and expanded quotas are fixed and filled by those ranking high in the annual and triennial exams.
phrases.There are six kinds of gongsheng: annual: There are six kinds of gongsheng: annual, grace, selected, excellent, secondary and by donation.
phrases.Every three years candidates are examine: Every three years candidates are examined in the provinces in the provincial exam; those who pass are juren.
phrases.Qing Shi Gao, vol. 108, Elections III, C: Qing Shi Gao, vol. 108, Elections III, Civil and Military Examinations
phrases.First place in the provincial exam is ca: First place in the provincial exam is called jieyuan.
phrases.The emperor examines candidates in perso: The emperor examines candidates in person at court, called the palace exam, ranking them in the first, second and third classes.
phrases.The second class, a number of men, is gr: The second class, a number of men, is granted the style jinshi chushen.
phrases.First place in the metropolitan exam is: First place in the metropolitan exam is called huiyuan.
phrases.The first class has three men — zhuangyu: The first class has three men — zhuangyuan, bangyan and tanhua — granted jinshi jidi.
phrases.Qing Shi Gao, vol. 108, Elections III (r: Qing Shi Gao, vol. 108, Elections III (ranks per vol. 115, Hanlin Academy)
phrases.Bangyan and tanhua are appointed compile: Bangyan and tanhua are appointed compilers.
phrases.The first-class zhuangyuan is appointed: The first-class zhuangyuan is appointed senior compiler.
phrases.没有功名和官职的普通平民，是求取功名的起点，无须通过考试取得；具备报考资格后，可: A commoner with no degree or office — the starting point of the examination ladder. No exam is needed to reach it, but once eligible one may sit the child exam.
phrases.参加县试、府试、院试等童试而尚未取得生员资格的读书人，年龄不限；通过相应选拔并获: A candidate who has sat the county, prefectural and academy exams but has not yet obtained licentiate status; there is no age limit. Only after passing and being admitted does one become a shengyuan.
phrases.童试某一场考试的第一名，本卡采用县试案首之义，即县试排名第一；这是考试名次，正式: The top scorer in one session of the child exam; this card adopts the county-exam sense — first place in the county exam. It is an exam ranking; formal licentiate status still depends on admission.
phrases.取得国子监学生身份或资格的人，可由恩赐、荫入、选优或捐纳等途径取得；符合规定者可: A person who has obtained Imperial Academy student status or eligibility, through imperial grace, hereditary privilege, selection or donation; qualified jiansheng may sit the provincial exam. It is not a mandatory stage after tongsheng.
phrases.俗称秀才，童生通过县试、府试及学政主持的院试选拔，获准进入府、州、县学学籍后取得: Commonly called xiucai. A tongsheng admitted to a prefectural, department or county school after passing the county, prefectural and academy exams; he must still be assessed to qualify for the provincial exam.
phrases.全称廪膳生员，是生员中的一种，通常由岁试、科试成绩优者按定额依次补入，可领取官府: Full title: stipended shengyuan. A category of shengyuan normally filled to quota by those with the best annual and triennial exam results; they receive the government stipend. Not every xiucai enjoys it at once.
phrases.通过岁贡、恩贡、拔贡等途径贡入国子监的读书人，各贡途分别依年资、考选、恩诏或捐纳: A scholar recommended into the Imperial Academy through the annual tribute, grace tribute, selection tribute and other channels, each obtained by seniority, examination, imperial grace or donation; distinct from the gongshi who pass the metropolitan exam.
phrases.合资格的生员、贡监生等参加乡试，中式后取得的功名；此后可参加会试，也有按规定入仕: The degree obtained by qualified shengyuan and tribute students who pass the provincial exam; they may then sit the metropolitan exam and are eligible for office under the rules, though passing does not mean immediate appointment.
phrases.一科乡试的第一名，由参加该场乡试的考生按成绩评定；身份仍属于举人，下一步可参加会: First place in one provincial examination, ranked by the candidates’ results; the holder is still a juren and may sit the metropolitan exam. It is not a separate degree beyond juren.
phrases.举人通过会试成为贡士，再经殿试获得的科名，分一甲、二甲、三甲；授官、选馆或候选另: The degree of a juren who becomes a gongshi in the metropolitan exam and then passes the palace exam, graded in the first, second and third classes; appointment or academy selection is handled separately, and the degree itself carries no rank.
phrases.殿试评定的第二等进士，赐“进士出身”，位列一甲三人之后；由贡士参加殿试后定等取得: Second-class jinshi in the palace exam, granted the style "jinshi chushen" and placed after the three first-class laureates; obtained by gongshi through the palace exam, not a further test after becoming a jinshi.
phrases.一科会试的第一名，由举人参加会试后按成绩评定，是同科贡士之首；后续殿试会重新评定: First place in one metropolitan exam, ranked by the juren’s results and heading the gongshi of that year; the palace exam re-ranks them, so a huiyuan is not guaranteed to become zhuangyuan.
phrases.殿试一甲第三名，赐“进士及第”，由贡士参加殿试后定名次取得；清代通常授翰林院编修: Third place in the first class of the palace exam, granted "jinshi jidi"; normally appointed Hanlin compiler in the Qing, the post ranking 7a.
phrases.殿试一甲第二名，赐“进士及第”，与状元、探花由同场殿试评定；清代通常授翰林院编修: Second place in the first class of the palace exam, granted "jinshi jidi", ranked with the zhuangyuan and tanhua in the same palace exam; normally appointed Hanlin compiler in the Qing, the post ranking 7a.
phrases.殿试一甲第一名，赐“进士及第”，由贡士参加殿试后定名次取得；清代通常授翰林院修撰: First place in the first class of the palace exam, granted "jinshi jidi"; normally appointed Hanlin senior compiler in the Qing, the post ranking 6b.
phrases.通过院试入府、县学者。着青衿，戴方巾，见官不跪，有免役特权。: One who has entered a prefectural or county school through the academy exam. He wears the blue gown and square cap, need not kneel before officials, and is exempt from corvée.
phrases.正七品，掌修国史、起居注，常由进士一甲三名及庶吉士留馆者授。: Rank 7a; compiles the dynastic history and imperial diaries, usually appointed from the top three jinshi and selected Hanlin bachelors.
phrases.从六品，状元专授之职，掌修国史。: Rank 6b; the post reserved for the zhuangyuan, in charge of compiling the dynastic history.
phrases.正六品，各部司官中最低一级，掌案牍与具体事务。: Rank 6a; the lowest level of ministry bureau officials, handling documents and concrete affairs.
phrases.正七品，一县之长。穿青色鹭鸶补服，掌一县政令、赋役、刑名。: Rank 7a; head of a county. Wears the blue egret badge and handles county orders, taxes and justice.
phrases.从四品，一府之长，辖数州县，掌一府政令。: Rank 4b; head of a prefecture governing several departments and counties, in charge of its administration.
phrases.从一品，辖一省或数省军政大权，如两江总督、直隶总督。: Rank 1b; holds civil and military authority over one or more provinces, such as the Viceroy of Liangjiang or Zhili.
phrases.正一品，殿阁大学士为文官最高荣衔，如文华殿、武英殿大学士。: Rank 1a; Grand Secretary of a palace hall, the highest honorary civil post, e.g. of Wenhua or Wuying Hall.
phrases.太师、太傅、太保，正一品，位极人臣，多为赠官或荣衔。: Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor and Grand Guardian, rank 1a, the highest station of a subject, often honorary.
phrases.白民，猶言白丁也。: A commoner (bai min) is what is meant by bai ding.
phrases.周亮工《书影》卷七 释白民条: Zhou Lianggong, Shu Ying, vol. 7, "Explaining bai min"
phrases.直省士子之試於郡縣及提學，為童子試，俗謂為小考，或小試。應試者曰童生: Candidates examined in prefectures and counties or by the education commissioner sit the child exam, commonly called the minor test; those sitting it are called tongsheng.
phrases.徐珂《清稗类钞》考试类 童试: Xu Ke, Qing Bai Lei Chao, Examinations, "Child Exam"

phrases.三年大比，試諸生於直省，曰鄉試，中式者為舉人。: Every three years candidates are examined in the provinces in the provincial exam; those who pass are juren.

phrases.鄉試第一曰解元: First place in the provincial exam is called jieyuan.

phrases.天子親策於廷，曰殿試，名第分一、二、三甲。: The emperor examines candidates in person at court, called the palace exam, ranking them in the first, second and third classes.
phrases.可升｜可入仕｜殿试二甲｜阶次 11/15: Rise · Eligible for office · Palace exam, 2nd class · Tier 11/15
phrases.二甲若干人，賜進士出身。: The second class, a number of men, is granted the style jinshi chushen.
phrases.會試第一曰會元: First place in the metropolitan exam is called huiyuan.
phrases.可入仕｜一甲第三｜阶次 13/15: Eligible for office · 1st class, 3rd place · Tier 13/15
phrases.一甲三人，曰狀元、榜眼、探花，賜進士及第。: The first class has three men — zhuangyuan, bangyan and tanhua — granted jinshi jidi.
phrases.《清史稿》卷一百八 选举三 文科武科（官品另据卷一百十五 翰林院）: Qing Shi Gao, vol. 108, Elections III (ranks per vol. 115, Hanlin Academy)
phrases.可入仕｜一甲第二｜阶次 14/15: Eligible for office · 1st class, 2nd place · Tier 14/15
phrases.榜眼、探花授編修: Bangyan and tanhua are appointed compilers.
phrases.可入仕｜一甲第一｜阶次 15/15: Eligible for office · 1st class, 1st place · Tier 15/15
phrases.一甲狀元授修撰: The first-class zhuangyuan is appointed senior compiler.
phrases.自「白丁」起步，沿科举阶次晋身，先登「状元」及第者胜。: Start as Baiding and rise through the exam tiers; the first to reach Zhuangyuan wins.
phrases.书生以人设特性与专属事件见长；名臣各有主动技能与每局次数限制。: Scholars shine through persona traits and unique events; notables each have an active skill with per-game limits.
phrases.点底部角色条即可为当前席位选角；席位之间会自动交换，不会重复。: Tap a character in the bottom strip to assign it; seats swap automatically and never repeat.
phrases.超擢：按判词越过常规阶次。: Leap: skip past the normal tier as the verdict says.
phrases.升转：同阶平移或序升。: Step up: shift within the tier or advance in order.
phrases.依判词晋身：按所在格的判词前进。: Advance by verdict: move as the verdict on your cell says.
phrases.降罚：按判词降黜。: Penalty: demote as the verdict says.
phrases.第 5 轮走完后，朝廷开京察：全体官员互相考绩，揪出「不谨」之人。: After round 5 the court opens the Capital Review: all officials assess one another and name the negligent.
phrases.轮到你时，点一名同僚「不谨」；拿不准就点「跳过指认」。: On your turn, mark one colleague as negligent; if unsure, tap Skip.
phrases.全部指认完毕，统一统计票数。: When all accusations are in, votes are tallied.
phrases.票数最高且唯一者被参劾，退 1 格。: The sole highest-voted official is impeached and moves back 1 cell.
phrases.最高票并列，或无人指认，则京察无事。: A tie for most votes, or no accusations, leaves the review without effect.
phrases.指认是公开的，会记进「纪事」。想先看别人怎么投，可以先跳过。: Accusations are public and recorded in the Chronicle. You may skip first to see how others vote.
phrases.清贫少年 · 勤学补拙：转出「才」并结算后，可弃置1张功能手牌换3点资望（每局2: Poor Youth · Diligence Compensates: after a Talent spin resolves, discard 1 action card for 3 Renown (twice per game).
phrases.寒门贫女 · 生计牵身：手牌≤1张时触发绣帕换书（弃资望换2张功能牌）: Humble Daughter · Bound by Livelihood: with 1 or fewer cards, trade Renown for 2 action cards.
phrases.世家儒生 · 家学积累：起始额外获得2张功能牌；转出「赃」额外失2点资望: Noble Scholar · Family Learning: start with 2 extra action cards; lose 2 extra Renown on a Graft spin.
phrases.草莽游侠 · 临机应变：转掷结束结算前，可弃1张手牌重掷（每局2次）: Wandering Ranger · Improviser: after spinning but before settling, discard 1 card to spin again (twice per game).
phrases.私塾老儒 · 温故知新：转出「才」并结算后，可支付1点资望从弃牌堆选1张功能牌入: Old Tutor · Learn Anew: after a Talent spin resolves, pay 1 Renown to take 1 action card from the discard pile (twice per game).
phrases.市井商女 · 周转有方：正常回合开始转掷前，可弃1张手牌换2张功能牌（每局2次）: Merchant Daughter · Resourceful: before spinning at the start of your turn, discard 1 card to draw 2 (twice per game).
phrases.打出参劾，先选择对象: Play Impeachment, then choose a target
phrases.接受参劾，退后一格: Accept the impeachment and move back one cell
phrases.打出辩白，抵消本次参劾: Play Defense to cancel this impeachment

phrases.自己的常规转掷最终为“才”，并完成走子及到格结算后，可以发动：额外获得2点资望，: When your normal spin ends on Talent, after the move and cell settlement, you may gain 2 extra Renown without changing this move's result.

phrases.刘墉，字崇如，山东诸城人，乾隆十六年进士。他曾任安徽、江苏学政，参与地方学务与士: Liu Yong, courtesy name Chongru, a native of Zhucheng, Shandong, passed the palace exam in 1751. He served as education commissioner in Anhui and Jiangsu, overseeing local schools and the testing of scholars, later rose to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Benevolence, and was also known for his calligraphy.
phrases.聚敛招祸：自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以支付2点资望，抽取2张功能牌，牌堆不足2: Hoard and Bring Ruin: at the start of your turn before spinning, pay 2 Renown to draw 2 action cards (needs at least 2 cards in the deck). phrases.自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以支付2点资望，抽取2张功能牌，牌堆不足2张时不能发: At the start of your turn before spinning, pay 2 Renown to draw 2 action cards (needs at least 2 cards in the deck). phrases.和珅，字致斋，钮祜禄氏，曾任军机大臣、大学士等要职，深受乾隆倚重。他利用权势收受: Heshen, courtesy name Zhizhai, of the Niohuru clan, held key posts including Grand Councillor and Grand Secretary and was deeply trusted by Qianlong. He used his power to take bribes and amass wealth; after Jiaqing took power he was investigated and granted suicide.
phrases.主动发动2次；首次发动后的附加风险持续生效，直至退出科举阶段。: 2 active uses; after the first use the added risk lasts until you leave the exam stage.
phrases.校书择要：自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以发动：查看功能牌堆顶3张牌，选择1张加入: Select the Essentials: at the start of your turn before spinning, look at the top 3 action cards, take 1 into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in their original order; with fewer than 3, look at all remaining cards; not usable with an empty deck.
phrases.自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以发动：查看功能牌堆顶3张牌，选择1张加入手牌，其余: At the start of your turn before spinning, look at the top 3 action cards, take 1 into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in their original order; with fewer than 3, look at all remaining cards; not usable with an empty deck.
phrases.乾隆、嘉庆时期／《四库全书》总纂官／学者: Qianlong–Jiaqing era / Chief Editor of the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries / Scholar
phrases.纪昀，字晓岚，直隶献县人，乾隆十九年进士。他学识广博，担任《四库全书》总纂官，与: Ji Yun, courtesy name Xiaolan, a native of Xianxian, Zhili, passed the palace exam in 1754. Widely learned, he served as chief editor of the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries, working with other scholars to organize texts and write summaries, and was skilled at drawing key points from vast materials.
phrases.周济寒士：自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以弃置1张功能手牌，立即获得2点资望；若本: Relieve Poor Scholars: at the start of your turn before spinning, discard 1 action card to gain 2 Renown immediately; if this turn's normal spin ends on Virtue, gain 1 more Renown after settlement. Not usable without a card.
phrases.自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以弃置1张功能手牌，立即获得2点资望；若本回合常规转: At the start of your turn before spinning, discard 1 action card to gain 2 Renown immediately; if this turn's normal spin ends on Virtue, gain 1 more Renown after settlement. Not usable without a card.
phrases.康熙至乾隆时期／范县、潍县知县／书画家: Kangxi–Qianlong era / Magistrate of Fanxian and Weixian / Painter-calligrapher
phrases.郑板桥，本名郑燮，字克柔，江苏兴化人，乾隆元年进士。他擅长诗文、书法和兰竹绘画，: Zheng Banqiao, originally Zheng Xie, courtesy name Kerou, a native of Xinghua, Jiangsu, passed the palace exam in 1736. He excelled in poetry, calligraphy and orchid-and-bamboo painting, served as a county magistrate, cared for neighbors and poor students, and once asked his family in a letter to share paper and brushes with needy schoolmates.
phrases.查禁除弊：对手的常规转掷最终为“赃”，待该次转掷及相关功能牌全部结算完毕后，若对: Suppress Abuse: when an opponent's normal spin ends on Graft, after that spin and all related cards resolve, if they still hold cards, you may make them choose and discard 1 action card; this is not an impeachment and cannot be canceled by Defense.
phrases.对手的常规转掷最终为“赃”，待该次转掷及相关功能牌全部结算完毕后，若对手仍有手牌: When an opponent's normal spin ends on Graft, after that spin and all related cards resolve, if they still hold cards, you may make them choose and discard 1 action card; this is not an impeachment and cannot be canceled by Defense.
phrases.嘉庆、道光时期／钦差大臣、督抚／禁烟大臣: Jiaqing–Daoguang era / Imperial Commissioner, Governor-General / Anti-opium minister
phrases.林则徐，字少穆，福建侯官人，嘉庆十六年进士。他曾治理水利、赈济灾民，道光十九年赴: Lin Zexu, courtesy name Shaomu, a native of Houguan, Fujian, passed the palace exam in 1811. He managed waterworks and relieved disaster victims; in 1839 he went to Guangdong to suppress opium and presided over the destruction at Humen, becoming known for his strict anti-drug and administrative reforms.
phrases.笃学有恒：自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以发动：从本回合起，在自己连续两个正常行动: Steady Learning: at the start of your turn before spinning, from this turn on, gain 2 Renown at the end of each of your next two normal turns; the effect ends after the second settlement. Skipped turns do not count; leaving the exam stage early or ending the game forfeits remaining gains.
phrases.自己的回合开始、转掷之前，可以发动：从本回合起，在自己连续两个正常行动回合结束时: At the start of your turn before spinning, from this turn on, gain 2 Renown at the end of each of your next two normal turns; the effect ends after the second settlement. phrases.道光、咸丰、同治时期／湘军统帅、两江总督／家书作者: Daoguang–Tongzhi era / Commander of the Xiang Army, Viceroy of Liangjiang / Author of family letters
phrases.曾国藩，字伯涵，号涤生，湖南湘乡人，道光年间进士。他组织湘军，参与镇压太平天国，: Zeng Guofan, courtesy name Bohan, style Disheng, a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan, passed the palace exam in the Daoguang era. He organized the Xiang Army against the Taiping, served as Viceroy of Liangjiang, and valued reading, self-cultivation and family education, stressing resolve, insight and perseverance.

phrases.和珅在位时，令奏事者俱副本送军机处；呈进方物，必先关白，擅自准驳，遇不全纳者悉入: While Heshen held office, he required memorialists to send copies to the Grand Council; gifts had to be reported first, and he arbitrarily approved or rejected them, keeping for himself all that was not fully offered.

html.intro.line1: Each turn, play one card or skip and spin.
html.intro.line2: Tap a card to read it, then press PLAY to confirm.
html.intro.line3: The top decides your fate: Virtue leap · Talent step up · Merit advance · Graft demote.
html.intro.line4: First to reach the Three Excellencies wins.

canhe.name: 参劾
canhe.desc: 点一名对手，使其后退一格；若对方有辩白则抵消。

bianbai.name: 辩白
bianbai.desc: 被参劾时打出，抵消本次参劾。

dadian.name: 打点
dadian.desc: 本轮若转出「赃」，免去退格/革职。

addrank.name: 加官
addrank.desc: 本轮转出「德/才」时，目的格按身份阶次再升 1 阶（位置不动）。

jiji.name: 带级
jiji.desc: 本轮升阶 + 前进 1 格，并摸 1 张牌。

qingke.name: 清客
qingke.desc: 本轮若转出「赃」，效果完全无效。
